candidates.name: Angiolymphoid Hyperplasia with Eosinophilia (ALHE)
support_spans: irregular red lacunae with irregular vessels and absence of septa
ectatic thin-walled vessels with multiple intravascular branching papillary structures
swollen endothelial cells with numerous intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules
candidates.why: The combination of dermoscopic and histopathological findings, including irregular red lacunae, ectatic thin-walled vessels, and intracytoplasmic hyaline globules, are characteristic of Angiolymphoid Hyperplasia with Eosinophilia (ALHE).

candidates.name: Angiolymphoid hyperplasia with eosinophilia
support_spans: irregular red lacunae with irregular vessels and absence of septa
ectatic thin-walled vessels with multiple intravascular branching papillary structures
swollen endothelial cells with numerous intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules
candidates.why: The presence of irregular red lacunae, ectatic thin-walled vessels, and intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules in endothelial cells are characteristic features of angiolymphoid hyperplasia with eosinophilia.

candidates.name: Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma
support_spans: irregular red lacunae without septa and irregular linear vessels
ectatic thin-walled vessels with multiple intravascular branching papillary structures
candidates.why: The dermoscopic and histopathological findings of irregular red lacunae and papillary structures are consistent with papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma.

candidates.why: The presence of papillary structures and hyaline globules in endothelial cells are characteristic features of Dabska tumor.

candidates.name: Papillary Intralymphatic Angioendothelioma
support_spans: intravascular branching papillary structures
tumor vessels were positive for CD-31
candidates.why: The presence of intravascular branching papillary structures and positivity for CD-31 are features that can be seen in Papillary Intralymphatic Angioendothelioma.

candidates.name: Dabska Tumor
support_spans: intravascular branching papillary structures
hyaline globules in the cytoplasm of endothelial cells
candidates.why: The presence of intravascular branching papillary structures and hyaline globules in endothelial cells are characteristic features of Dabska Tumor.

selector.rationale: Evidence of ectatic thin-walled vessels with multiple intravascular branching papillary structures and swollen endothelial cells with numerous intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules best supports Dabska tumor without contradiction.

rejected.label: Angiolymphoid Hyperplasia with Eosinophilia (ALHE)
rejected.why: Less specific evidence support and lower score_logit compared to Dabska tumor and Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma.
